title: Climb Global Solutions, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Climb Global Solutions, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that director Gerri Gold will retire from the Board and will not stand for re-election at the 2026 annual meeting. The Board has decided to reduce its size from five to four directors effective at the Annual Meeting.
key_points: Director Gerri Gold notified the Board on April 20, 2026, that she will retire and will not stand for re-election
Ms. Gold will continue to serve until the expiration of her term at the 2026 Annual Meeting
The departure was not due to any dispute or disagreement with the Company
The Board reduced its size from five to four directors effective at the Annual Meeting
The filing was signed by CFO Matthew Sullivan on April 23, 2026
